doc: Read a field of matter by material and in units, place a material, apply a quantity, ask why a cell is what it is, what happened, and what would.

tools.name: matter.describe
tools.description: What the world is made of: its materials, its channels with their units, its laws by name, kind and place in the definition; one material's properties or one law in full when named

material.description: this material's properties: what differs from the columns' defaults

law.description: this law in full: its condition as written, what it changes

tools.name: matter.observe
tools.description: A region as matter: how many cells of each material, each channel in its unit (least, most, mean), how many cells are in each named state (burning)

region.description: [x, y, width, height] in cells (the whole field when none is given)

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: channels, then materials, are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: matter.at
tools.description: One cell: its material and phase, its channels in their units, and its properties where its state leaves them other than written (wet: a higher ignition)

tools.name: matter.place
tools.description: Makes a region of a material anew — every channel as a new instance of it has — in one frame, recorded with who placed it
tools.undo: field.seek to the frame before it

tools.name: matter.apply
tools.description: A quantity applied to a region — a channel set to, raised by or lowered by an amount in its unit (heat: temperature add 400) — in one frame, recorded with who applied it
tools.undo: field.seek to the frame before it

channel.description: its name: temperature, wetness, charge, pressure …

set.description: to this, in the channel's unit

tools.name: matter.explain
tools.description: Why a cell is what it is: what is on record of it, the latest first — the law that held (its name, its condition, its place in the definition), what the law read, and the neighbours' parts: who gave what it needed, who took it away, what was beside it when something ran short, each followed to its own cause and to who placed or applied what — and, for a law named, whether it holds now and which comparison fails

law.description: judge this law for the cell as it is now: held, or what fails

depth.description: how far back along the givers' own causes (2 when none is given; 0 … 6)

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: older records are left out, and `more` says how many

tools.name: matter.events
tools.description: What happened, oldest first: cells that became another material (by which law), named states begun and ended (ignite, go_out), edits and their actors — since a frame, of a name, in a region

since.description: records of frames after this one (all kept when none is given)

name.description: only events of this name: ignite, boil, melt, placed …

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: the latest are kept, and `more` says how many older are left out

tools.name: matter.branch
tools.description: What would be: the field some steps ahead — a material placed or a quantity applied first when given — as the materials of a region with their change, and the events that would happen, counted by name; the field itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

apply.description: {channel, set | add | take, region}: applied before the steps

region.description: the region observed (the whole field when none is given)
